name: Disjoint Two-Support Family
definition: Partition $[2k]$ into pairs $B_1,\ldots,B_k$ and take the $k$ concepts whose supports are the individual blocks $B_i$.
properties: It has ordering width three, Yang depth defect $k+1$ over every field, and daisy completion defect at most $2k+1$. Thus an exponential lower bound on daisy defect in terms of Yang depth fails for general concept classes.
